transcript.text: Hi everyone. We've got the offline-sync engine rollout scheduled for Wednesday production. The engine has passed its functional and staging reliability tests, which is good. Before I can record the rollout plan, our release-readiness routine requires final status from mobile engineering, reliability, customer support, and privacy. I'd like to go around and get each of your final sign-offs so we can proceed. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Before we proceed with sign-offs, I need to share some findings from my traffic replay testing. I measured the production sync queue and confirmed that a rollout above 5 percent would exceed the queue's safe processing margin. I also confirmed that reliability needs a 30-minute observation period after enabling the flag before we can proceed further. I haven't added these numbers to the release ticket yet, but I'm sharing them now so they can inform the rollout plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Before I give my customer support sign-off, I need to share something I found while preparing support coverage. I've confirmed from current support cases that the Aurora and Helix enterprise accounts have active offline workflows and must be excluded from the first rollout until their account teams complete a separate acceptance check. I haven't posted this account list in the release channel yet, but we need to account for these exclusions in the rollout plan before I can sign off.
